描述_ZN: The painting "Planting Autumn Flowers" on a scroll, Qing dynasty, painted by Yu Shen, on paper with color, 165.8 cm in length and 93.7 cm in width.　　According to the title after the poem "Poem on Planting Autumn Flowers" in the imperial handwriting of the Qianlong emperor at the top of this panel, "The work of planting autumn flowers on the right was ordered to be illustrated with poetic meaning. It was written by the Emperor in the early autumn of the Qianlong reign." It is clear that Yu Province's painting "Planting Autumn Flowers" was made by order. The signature reads, "Painted by Yu Shen Gong." Inscriptions of "Yu" and "Province" are linked. The marks of connoisseurship include: "A treasure of the Qianlong imperial inspection", "To cultivate the spirit of nature", "Watching books for pleasure", "Containing the hairs of a remote", and "Yunxia Si". The seal of the collection includes: "The treasure of the Qianlong imperial inspection", "The cultivation of the spirit", "The pleasure of watching calligraphy", "Containing the brush in a remote place", "Yunxia Si", "Qianlong Chenhan", and "A few leisurely moments in the pool".　　The year "C.Y." is the eleventh year of the Qianlong era (1746).　　The painting is a panoramic composition, showing children planting autumn flowers. The upper part of the painting shows the autumn season with distant mountains and green trees, while the lower part highlights the theme of the painting, which is the planting of autumn flowers. In the courtyard, some children plant in the open space in front of the house, while others cultivate and water the planted autumn flowers. In the painting, the autumn flowers are colorful, and two or three bees and butterflies linger around the hedge path. The whole picture is vivid and lively, with beautiful colors, pleasing to the eye, showing the pleasant life of people living in peace and happiness.　　Recorded in Shiqu Baoji, Part III.
